provenance.basis: Chart colours are the first six slots of the dataviz skill reference palette in fixed order (blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green), validated with its script against a white card: CVD adjacent dE 9.1, normal-vision 19.6 (the sixth slot, green, was added for the home and changes neither number). Aqua, yellow and magenta sit below 3:1 on white, so every chart ships a legend, a readout and a year-by-year table. Entities keep their colour everywhere: cash blue, fixed deposits orange, provident funds aqua, gold yellow, equity magenta, home green. Loans are neutral grey (they hang below the axis). Dark scheme (follows the device setting): page and card colours are game choices (ink on background 16:1, secondary ink 10:1, dark ink on the yellow highlight 10:1); the chart colours are the reference palette's dark steps (blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green), validated with its script against its dark surface #1a1a19: CVD adjacent dE 8.4, normal-vision 19.3, all six at least 3:1. The chart card here is a slightly purple dark (#1f1c33) rather than #1a1a19, a near-identical surface, so the validated numbers carry over.
